name: Dan Scavino
current_role: White House Deputy Chief of Staff (since January 2025) and Director of the Presidential Personnel Office (since October 2025)
summary: Dan Scavino has worked for Donald Trump since he caddied for him as a teenager in 1990, later managing a Trump golf club and running Trump’s social media in the first administration. A deputy chief of staff since January 2025, he also took over the Presidential Personnel Office in October 2025, when Sergio Gor left to become ambassador to India, giving him charge of selecting nearly all political appointees.
